title: Biomedical Micro- and Nanorobots in Disease Treatment
description:
Biomedical Micro- and Nanorobots in Disease Treatment

Comprehensive resource covering fundamentals at the micro and nano scales, technical advances in micro- and nanorobots, and their biomedical applications

Biomedical Micro- and Nanorobots in Disease Treatment: Design, Preparation, and Applications provides foundational knowledge on the subject in the fields of biomaterials, nanotechnology, and biomedicine, discusses the applications of micro- and nanorobots in the cardiovascular, cancer, ophthalmic, orthopedic, gastrointestinal, and nervous system disease treatment, and addresses their biosafety, autonomous motion behavior, and future development trends.

The two highly qualified authors comprehensively and systematically introduces the concept source, definition, classification, autonomous movement behavior, and functionality of the technology, providing readers with new ideas, technologies, and methods for modern biomedical research, while also expanding new disease diagnosis, treatment principles, and possible application modes to paint a complete picture of the potential of the technology.

Sample topics covered in Biomedical Micro- and Nanorobots in Disease Treatment: Design, Preparation, and Applications include:

Substrate selection between metal, inorganic, organic, natural, and hybrid materials, as well as driving systems based on biological components, external fields, and chemical reactions
In vivo tracking technologies, including fluorescence imaging, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), radionuclide and ultrasonic imaging, and other imaging methods
Biosafety of micro- and nanorobot substrate through material composition, micro- and nanoscale influence, ultimate destiny, and genotoxicity
Trending behavior mechanisms in magnetotactic, phototactic, and chemotaxis systems, and motion control through speed and direction control modes
Study on therapeutic mechanism and application for various physiological diseases

Summarizing research progress in the preparation, biosafety, functionality, and therapeutic effects of the technology, Biomedical Micro- and Nanorobots in Disease Treatment: Design, Preparation, and Applications is an important and timely resource for biochemists, materials scientists, medicinal chemists, pharmaceutical chemists, bioengineers, biotechnologists, and the greater biotechnological industry.
translatedDescription:
Micro- y Nanorobots biomédicos en tratamiento de enfermedades

Recursos integrales que cubren los fundamentos a escala micro y nano, avances técnicos en micro y nanorobots, y sus aplicaciones biomédicas

Micro- y Nanorobots Biomédicos en Tratamiento de Enfermedades: Diseño, Preparación y Aplicaciones proporciona conocimiento fundamental sobre el tema en los campos de biomateriales, nanotecnología y biomedicina, analiza las aplicaciones de micro- y nanorobots en el tratamiento cardiovascular, cáncer, oftalmológico, ortopédico, gastrointestinal y sistema nervioso, y aborda su bioseguridad, tendencias autónomas de movimiento, y desarrollo futuro.

Los dos autores altamente cualificados introducen de manera integral y sistemática la fuente de concepto, definición, clasificación, comportamiento autónomo y funcionalidad de la tecnología, proporcionando a los lectores nuevas ideas, tecnologías y métodos para la investigación biomédica moderna, al mismo tiempo que amplían nuevos diagnósticos de enfermedades, principios de tratamiento y posibles modos de aplicación para pintar un cuadro completo del potencial de la tecnología.

Temas de muestra cubiertos en Micro-biomédicos y Nanorobots en Tratamiento de Enfermedades: Diseño, Preparación y Aplicaciones incluyen:

Substrate selection between metal, inorgic, organic, natural, and Hybrid materials, as well as driving systems based on biological components, external fields, and chemical reactions
Tecnologías de seguimiento in vivo, incluyendo imágenes de fluorescencia, resonancia magnética (MRI), radionúclido e imágenes ultrasónicas, y otros métodos de imagen
Biosafety of micro- and nanorobot substrate through material composition, micro- and nanoscale influence, ultimate destination, and genotoxicity
Mecanismos de comportamiento de tendencia en sistemas magnetotácticos, fototácticos y quimiotaxis, y control de movimiento a través de modos de control de velocidad y dirección
Estudio sobre mecanismo terapéutico y aplicación de diversas enfermedades fisiológicas

Summarizing research progress in the preparation, biosafety, functions, and therapeutic effects of the technology, Biomedical Micro- and Nanorobots in Disease Treatment: Design, Preparation, and Applications is an important and timely resource for biochemists, materials scientists, medical chemists, pharmaceutical chemists, bioengineers, biotechnologists, and the greater biotechnological industry.

title: Excel Scientific and Engineering Cookbook
description:
Given the improved analytical capabilities of Excel, scientists and engineers everywhere are using it--instead of FORTRAN--to solve problems. And why not? Excel is installed on millions of computers, features a rich set of built-in analyses tools, and includes an integrated Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) programming language. No wonder it's today's computing tool of choice.

Chances are you already use Excel to perform some fairly routine calculations. Now the Excel Scientific and Engineering Cookbook shows you how to leverage Excel to perform more complex calculations, too, calculations that once fell in the domain of specialized tools. It does so by putting a smorgasbord of data analysis techniques right at your fingertips. The book shows how to perform these useful tasks and others:

Use Excel and VBA in general
Import data from a variety of sources
Analyze data
Perform calculations
Visualize the results for interpretation and presentation
Use Excel to solve specific science and engineering problems

Wherever possible, the Excel Scientific and Engineering Cookbook draws on real-world examples from a range of scientific disciplines such as biology, chemistry, and physics. This way, you'll be better prepared to solve the problems you face in your everyday scientific or engineering tasks.

High on practicality and low on theory, this quick, look-up reference provides instant solutions, or "recipes," to problems both basic and advanced. And like other books in O'Reilly's popular Cookbook format, each recipe also includes a discussion on how and why it works. As a result, you can take comfort in knowing that complete, practical answers are a mere page-flip away.

No me extraña que sea la herramienta de informática de hoy.

Es posible que ya use Excel para realizar algunos cálculos bastante rutinarios. Ahora el Excel Scientific and Engineering Cookbook le muestra cómo aprovechar Excel para realizar cálculos más complejos, también, cálculos que una vez cayeron en el dominio de herramientas especializadas. Lo hace poniendo un smorgasbord de técnicas de análisis de datos a su alcance. El libro muestra cómo realizar estas tareas útiles y otras:

Use Excel y VBA en general
Importar datos de diversas fuentes
Analizar datos
Realizar cálculos
Visualizar los resultados de interpretación y presentación
Utilice Excel para resolver problemas específicos de ciencia e ingeniería

Siempre que sea posible, el Excel Scientific and Engineering Cookbook aprovecha ejemplos reales de una serie de disciplinas científicas como la biología, la química y la física. De esta manera, estarás mejor preparado para resolver los problemas que enfrentas en tus tareas científicas o de ingeniería cotidianas.

Alto en la práctica y bajo en la teoría, esta referencia rápida y de búsqueda proporciona soluciones instantáneas, o "recetas", a problemas tanto básicos como avanzados. Y como otros libros en el popular formato Cookbook de O'Reilly, cada receta también incluye una discusión sobre cómo y por qué funciona. Como resultado, usted puede tomar la comodidad en saber que las respuestas completas y prácticas son una mera página-flip de distancia.

title: Interdisciplinary Behavior and Social Sciences
description:
The human aspect plays an important role in the social sciences. The behavior of people has become a vital area of focus in the social sciences as well. Interdisciplinary Behavior and Social Sciences contains papers that were originally presented at the 3rd International Congress on Interdisciplinary Behavior and Social Science 2014 (ICIBSoS 2014), held 1–2 November 2014 at the Bali Dynasty Resort, Kuta, Bali, Indonesia.

The contributions deal with various interdisciplinary research topics, particularly in the fields of social sciences, education, economics and arts. The papers focus especially on such topics as language, cultural studies, economics, behavior studies, political sciences, media and communication, psychology and human development.

This printed abstracts volume (92 pp) comes with a full paper CD-ROM (448 pp).

El aspecto humano desempeña un papel importante en las ciencias sociales. El comportamiento de las personas se ha convertido en un área vital de enfoque en las ciencias sociales también. Comportamiento Interdisciplinario y Ciencias Sociales contiene documentos que fueron presentados originalmente en el 3er Congreso Internacional sobre Comportamiento Interdisciplinario y Ciencias Sociales 2014 (ICIBSoS 2014), celebrado del 1 al 2 de noviembre de 2014 en el Bali Dynasty Resort, Kuta, Bali, Indonesia.

Las contribuciones se refieren a diversos temas de investigación interdisciplinaria, especialmente en las esferas de las ciencias sociales, la educación, la economía y las artes. Los documentos se centran especialmente en temas como lenguaje, estudios culturales, economía, estudios de comportamiento, ciencias políticas, medios de comunicación y comunicación, psicología y desarrollo humano.

Este volumen de abstracts impresos (92 pp) viene con un CD-ROM de papel completo (448 pp).

title: Securing Microservice APIs
description:
There are several techniques for controlling access to web APIs in microservice architectures, ranging from network controls to cryptographic methods and platform-based capabilities. This short ebook introduces an API access control model that you can implement on a single platform or across multiple platforms to provide cohesive security across your network of microservices.

Until now, speed of delivery rather than security has motivated organizations to adopt a microservices architecture. Authors Matt McLarty and Rob Wilson propose a vocabulary and model for logical and physical systems of microservices, review current practices for web API access control in a microservice architecture, and present DHARMA—a comprehensive, platform independent approach to API access control.

This ebook is ideal for architects, product owners, development leaders, platform teams, and operational managers.

This ebook includes:

A platform-neutral overview of the microservices landscape
Current network-, trust-, and platform-based security technologies and solutions that apply to microservice APIs
The proposed DHARMA cross-platform model for securing microservice API access control
A word on the future direction of microservice API security
translatedDescription:
Existen varias técnicas para controlar el acceso a las API web en arquitecturas de microservicio, desde controles de red hasta métodos criptográficos y capacidades basadas en plataformas. Este breve ebook introduce un modelo de control de acceso de API que puede implementar en una sola plataforma o en varias plataformas para proporcionar seguridad cohesiva a través de su red de microservicios.

Hasta ahora, la velocidad de entrega en lugar de la seguridad ha motivado a las organizaciones a adoptar una arquitectura de microservicios. Los autores Matt McLarty y Rob Wilson proponen un vocabulario y un modelo para sistemas lógicos y físicos de microservicios, revisan las prácticas actuales para el control de acceso a la API web en una arquitectura de microservicio y presentan DHARMA, un enfoque integral e independiente de plataforma para el control de acceso a la API.

Este ebook es ideal para arquitectos, propietarios de productos, líderes de desarrollo, equipos de plataforma y administradores operativos.

Este ebook incluye:

Un panorama neutro de la plataforma del paisaje de los microservicios
Tecnologías y soluciones actuales de seguridad basadas en la red, la confianza y la plataforma que se aplican a las API de microservicio
El modelo multiplataforma DHARMA propuesto para asegurar el control de acceso a microservicio API
Una palabra sobre la dirección futura de seguridad de microservicio API

title: Heat Transfer
description: This volume begins with coverage of the basic knowledge necessary to understand and solve simple electronic cooling problems, then explores details on heat transfer fundamentals to give the reader a deeper understanding of associated physics. Next, the author describes experimental and numerical techniques and tools used in a typical thermal design process and follows with a chapter on some advanced cooling techniques. With its comprehensive coverage of thermal design, this book helps engineers to develop the necessary expertise in thermal management of electronics, and to move a step closer to being a multidisciplinary engineer.
translatedDescription: Este volumen comienza con la cobertura de los conocimientos básicos necesarios para comprender y resolver problemas simples de refrigeración electrónica, luego explora detalles sobre los fundamentos de transferencia de calor para dar al lector una comprensión más profunda de la física asociada. A continuación, el autor describe técnicas y herramientas experimentales y numéricas utilizadas en un proceso de diseño térmico típico y sigue un capítulo sobre algunas técnicas avanzadas de refrigeración. Con su amplia cobertura de diseño térmico, este libro ayuda a los ingenieros a desarrollar la experiencia necesaria en la gestión térmica de la electrónica, y a acercarse un paso más a ser un ingeniero multidisciplinar.

title: Pearson Nvision Foundation'2025 Physics Class 9, Content Revised As Per the Latest NCERT Syllabus, Useful for School and Exams Like JEE, NEET, NSO, IOM, IMO, NSTSE, IOS, 2nd Edition
description:
Pearson NVision Series is a range of books to help learners go beyond the school curriculum and attain competitive edge. Based on the latest NCERT curriculum, NVision chapters begin with theoretical concepts, closely accompanied with in-text exercises, checkpoints, important notes, solved examples, diagrams, tables, and activities.

The concepts and exercises in the book are designed to prepare students for exams such as JEE, NEET, and Olympiads like NSO, IOM, IMO, NSTSE, and IOS. The exercises are divided into three levels of difficulty, helping learners first understand the concepts, then apply them, and finally practice previous years’ questions to become exam ready.

Features –

💡Exclusive experienced brand of authors from PAN India have written the books.

📚Concept Maps at the end of Every Chapter.

🔥Activity Box after almost every concept (subject and grade specific, as required).

🔍Check Point section for checking the student’s understanding of the concepts.

💡Archieve Corner containing questions of the level of exams like NTSE, SOF (NSO and IMO), and NVS.

📚Bridge to the Next Class section to help students prepare for the next level of content.

🔍Solved example section will have a completely new set of questions and solutions designed.

💡Extensive digital support – Motivational Videos, Exam Strategy, and Preparation Guide Videos, Selected Concept Videos/Infographics, and Worksheets.

title: Music Science
description:
Big data has come to the music business in a huge way. Nearly every aspect of the modern music industry relies on massive amounts of data, machine learning, and analytics to make better decisions faster. In this report, O’Reilly Strata + Hadoop World Chair Alistair Croll takes you on a tour of music science, a relatively new field staffed by data scientists, analytics experts, tastemakers, economists, and even game theorists.

Based on months of research and more than 70 interviews with scientists, founders, and artists, this report provides an overview of this multibillion-dollar venture. You’ll not only see where music science stands today—and where it’s headed—but get a tantalizing glimpse of what other industries will look like in coming years.

You’ll explore:

Connected listening: the new supply chain from artist to listener
The rise of metadata and the sheer volume of data associated with songs
Recommendations and Pandora’s Music Genome Project
Many ways to measure music consumption (and music consumers)
Music science’s Turing problems, such as the problem of predicting hit songs
How algorithms on listener preference need to learn quickly with fresh data
What lies on the horizon for the music industry

Los grandes datos han llegado al negocio de la música de una manera enorme. Casi todos los aspectos de la industria moderna de la música dependen de cantidades masivas de datos, aprendizaje automático y análisis para tomar mejores decisiones más rápido. En este informe, O'Reilly Strata + Hadoop World Chair Alistair Croll le lleva a un recorrido por la ciencia de la música, un campo relativamente nuevo formado por científicos de datos, expertos en analítica, diseñadores, economistas e incluso teoristas del juego.

Basado en meses de investigación y más de 70 entrevistas con científicos, fundadores y artistas, este informe ofrece una visión general de esta empresa multimillonaria. No sólo verás dónde se encuentra la ciencia de la música hoy —y a dónde se dirige— sino que obtendrás una visión tantalizadora de cómo se verán otras industrias en los próximos años.

Explorarás:

Escucha conectada: la nueva cadena de suministro de artista a oyente
El aumento de los metadatos y el volumen de los datos asociados a las canciones
Recomendaciones y el proyecto del genoma musical de Pandora
Muchas maneras de medir el consumo de música (y los consumidores de música)
Problemas de Turing de la ciencia musical, como el problema de predecir canciones de éxito
Cómo los algoritmos en la preferencia del oyente necesitan aprender rápidamente con datos frescos
Lo que está en el horizonte para la industria musical

title: A Modern Theory of Random Variation: With Applications in Stochastic Calculus, Financial Mathematics, and Feynman Integration
description:
A ground-breaking and practical treatment of probability and stochastic processes

A Modern Theory of Random Variation is a new and radical re-formulation of the mathematical underpinnings of subjects as diverse as investment, communication engineering, and quantum mechanics. Setting aside the classical theory of probability measure spaces, the book utilizes a mathematically rigorous version of the theory of random variation that bases itself exclusively on finitely additive probability distribution functions.

In place of twentieth century Lebesgue integration and measure theory, the author uses the simpler concept of Riemann sums, and the non-absolute Riemann-type integration of Henstock. Readers are supplied with an accessible approach to standard elements of probability theory such as the central limmit theorem and Brownian motion as well as remarkable, new results on Feynman diagrams and stochastic integrals.

Throughout the book, detailed numerical demonstrations accompany the discussions of abstract mathematical theory, from the simplest elements of the subject to the most complex. In addition, an array of numerical examples and vivid illustrations showcase how the presented methods and applications can be undertaken at various levels of complexity.

A Modern Theory of Random Variation is a suitable book for courses on mathematical analysis, probability theory, and mathematical finance at the upper-undergraduate and graduate levels. The book is also an indispensible resource for researchers and practitioners who are seeking new concepts, techniques and methodologies in data analysis, numerical calculation, and financial asset valuation.

Patrick Muldowney, PhD, served as lecturer at the Magee Business School of the UNiversity of Ulster for over twenty years. Dr. Muldowney has published extensively in his areas of research, including integration theory, financial mathematics, and random variation.
translatedDescription:
Un tratamiento innovador y práctico de probabilidad y procesos estocásticos

Una Teoría Moderna de la Variación Aleatoria es una nueva y radical re-formación de los fundamentos matemáticos de temas tan diversos como inversión, ingeniería de comunicación y mecánica cuántica. Al margen de la teoría clásica de espacios de medición de probabilidad, el libro utiliza una versión matemáticamente rigurosa de la teoría de la variación aleatoria que se basa exclusivamente en funciones de distribución de probabilidad aditiva finitamente.

En lugar de la teoría de integración y medición del Lebesgue del siglo XX, el autor utiliza el concepto más simple de las sumas Riemann, y la integración no absoluta del tipo Riemann de Henstock. Los lectores se suministran con un enfoque accesible a los elementos estándar de la teoría de la probabilidad, como el teorema central de la lima y el movimiento marroniano, así como nuevos resultados sobre diagramas Feynman e integrales estocásticos.

A lo largo del libro, demostraciones numéricas detalladas acompañan las discusiones de la teoría matemática abstracta, de los elementos más simples del tema a los más complejos. Además, una serie de ejemplos numéricos e ilustraciones vívidas muestran cómo se pueden llevar a cabo los métodos y aplicaciones presentados en diversos niveles de complejidad.

Una Teoría Moderna de la Variación Aleatoria es un libro adecuado para cursos sobre análisis matemático, teoría de probabilidad y finanzas matemáticas en los niveles de alto grado y graduado. El libro es también un recurso indispensable para investigadores y profesionales que buscan nuevos conceptos, técnicas y metodologías en análisis de datos, cálculo numérico y valoración de activos financieros.

Patrick Muldowney, PhD, sirvió como profesor en la Magee Business School de la UNiversity of Ulster durante más de veinte años. El Dr. Muldowney ha publicado extensamente en sus áreas de investigación, incluyendo teoría de la integración, matemáticas financieras y variación aleatoria.

title: Carbon Free
description:
It’s now or never. The goal of achieving global climate neutrality is essential for ecological, economic and social reasons and requires immediate and decisive action from politicians and society. Carbon Free summarizes the building blocks we need to successfully manage the energy transition.

Replete with international examples, the book’s first part explores the transformation of the energy markets, necessary accompanying redistributions, the often neglected issue of global population development, but also the ethical and political framework conditions under which the energy transition should take place. Part II deals with sector-specific topics including renewable energies, heat pumps, geothermal energy and solar thermal energy. Levelized costs of energy in the context of innovation promotion and the financing method of project financing are presented. The chapters in this part discuss implementation of strategic energy partnerships and how to shape future regulatory steps. The book’s third part then goes on to discuss the available toolbox, with contributions on the technical and economic perspectives of green hydrogen, grid infrastructures, digitalization as well as the circular economy.

This book will benefit both scholars and practitioners with its unique overview of the elements that need to be taken into account in order for the energy transition to succeed.
translatedDescription:
Es ahora o nunca. El objetivo de lograr la neutralidad climática mundial es esencial para las razones ecológicas, económicas y sociales y requiere una acción inmediata y decisiva de los políticos y la sociedad. Carbon Libre resume los bloques de construcción que necesitamos para gestionar con éxito la transición energética.

Repleto de ejemplos internacionales, la primera parte del libro explora la transformación de los mercados energéticos, las redistribuciones necesarias que acompañan, la cuestión a menudo desatendida del desarrollo de la población mundial, pero también las condiciones de marco ético y político en que debe realizarse la transición energética. La parte II se ocupa de temas específicos del sector, incluyendo energías renovables, bombas de calor, energía geotérmica y energía solar térmica. En el contexto de la promoción de la innovación y el método de financiación de la financiación de proyectos se presentan costos de nivelación de la energía. En los capítulos de esta parte se examina la aplicación de alianzas estratégicas en materia de energía y la forma de adoptar medidas reglamentarias futuras. La tercera parte del libro continúa para discutir la caja de herramientas disponible, con contribuciones en las perspectivas técnicas y económicas del hidrógeno verde, infraestructuras de red, digitalización y economía circular.

Este libro beneficiará tanto a académicos como a profesionales con su visión general única de los elementos que deben tenerse en cuenta para que la transición energética tenga éxito.

title: The Craft of Information Visualization
description: Since the beginning of the computer age, researchers from many disciplines have sought to facilitate people's use of computers and to provide ways for scientists to make sense of the immense quantities of data coming out of them. One gainful result of these efforts has been the field of information visualization, whose technology is increasingly applied in scientific research, digital libraries, data mining, financial data analysis, market studies, manufacturing production control, and data discovery.This book collects 38 of the key papers on information visualization from a leading and prominent research lab, the University of Maryland’s Human-Computer Interaction Lab (HCIL). Celebrating HCIL’s 20th anniversary, this book presents a coherent body of work from a respected community that has had many success stories with its research and commercial spin-offs. Each chapter contains an introduction specifically written for this volume by two leading HCI researchers, to describe the connections among those papers and reveal HCIL’s individual approach to developing innovations.*Presents key ideas, novel interfaces, and major applications of information visualization tools, embedded in inspirational prototypes.*Techniques can be widely applied in scientific research, digital libraries, data mining, financial data analysis, business market studies, manufacturing production control, drug discovery, and genomic studies.*Provides an "insider" view to the scientific process and evolution of innovation, as told by the researchers themselves.*This work comes from the prominent and high profile University of Maryland's Human Computer Interaction Lab

Un resultado positivo de estos esfuerzos ha sido el campo de la visualización de la información, cuya tecnología se aplica cada vez más en investigación científica, bibliotecas digitales, minería de datos, análisis de datos financieros, estudios de mercado, control de producción de manufacturas y descubrimiento de datos. description:
Lessons from HubSpot, Salesforce, Gainsight and Other Iconic Brands

"The Uber of this"

"The Salesforce of that"

"It's like Instagram, but for…"

There is no such thing as an original idea anymore – right? Actually, it turns out that the world’s most innovative companies have created so much more than just brand new products and technology. They've created entirely new market categories. The challenge is that successfully building new categories requires a perfect storm of luck and timing.

Or does it? Category Creation is the first and only book on the topic written by executives and marketers actively building new categories. It explains how category creation has become the Holy Grail of marketing, and more importantly, how it can be planned and orchestrated. It's not about luck. You can use the same tactics that other category-defining companies have used to delight customers, employees, and investors. There’s no better strategy that results in faster growth and higher valuations for the company on top.

Author Anthony Kennada, former Chief Marketing Officer at Gainsight, explains how he led Gainsight in creating the “customer success” category, and shares success stories from fellow category-creators like Salesforce, HubSpot and others. It requires much more than just having the best product. You have to start and grow a conversation that doesn’t yet exist, positioning a newly discovered problem in addition to your company and product offerings. The book explains the 7 key principles of category creation, including the importance of creating a community of early adopters who will rally around the problem they all share—especially if someone will lead them.

·       Identify the “go” and “no go” signals for category creation in your business

·       Activate customers and influencers as brand ambassadors

·       Grow a community by investing in live events and experiences

·       Prove the impact of category creation investments on growth, customer success, and company culture

Written for entrepreneurs, marketers, and executives from startups to large enterprises, Category Creation is the exclusive playbook for building a category defining brand in the modern economy.

title: Lies, Damned Lies, and Science: How to Sort through the Noise around Global Warming, the Latest Health Claims, and Other Scientific Controversies
description:
“Comprehensive, readable, and replete with current, useful examples, this book provides a much-needed explanation of how to be a critical consumer of the scientific claims we encounter in our everyday lives.”

–April Cordero Maskiewicz, Department of Biology, Point Loma Nazarene University

“Seethaler’s book helps the reader look inside the workings of science and gain a deeper understanding of the pathway that is followed by a scientific finding–from its beginnings in a research lab to its appearance on the nightly news.”

–Jim Slotta, Ontario Institute for Studies in Education, University of Toronto

“How I wish science was taught this way! Seethaler builds skills for critical thinking and evaluation. The book is rich with examples that not only illustrate her points beautifully, they also make it very interesting and fun to read.”

–Julia R. Brown, Director, Targacept, Inc.

Don’t Get Hoodwinked! Make Sense of Health and Science News...and Make Smarter Decisions!

Every day, there’s a new scientific or health controversy. And every day, it seems as if there’s a new study that contradicts what you heard yesterday. What’s really going on? Who’s telling the truth? Who’s faking it? What do scientists actually know—and what don’t they know? This book will help you cut through the confusion and make sense of it all—even if you’ve never taken a science class! Leading science educator and journalist Dr. Sherry Seethaler reveals how science and health research really work...how to put scientific claims in context and understand the real tradeoffs involved...tell quality research from junk science...discover when someone’s deliberately trying to fool you...and find more information you can trust!  Nobody knows what new controversy will erupt tomorrow. But one thing’s for certain: With this book, you’ll know how to figure out the real deal—and make smarter decisions for yourself and your family!

Watch the news, and you’ll be overwhelmed by snippets of badly presented science: information that’s incomplete, confusing, contradictory, out-of-context, wrong, or flat-out dishonest. Defend yourself! Dr. Sherry Seethaler gives you a powerful arsenal of tools for making sense of science. You’ll learn how to think more sensibly about everything from mad cow disease to global warming–and how to make better science-related decisions in both your personal life and as a citizen.

You’ll begin by understanding how science really works and progresses, and why scientists sometimes disagree. Seethaler helps you assess the possible biases of those who make scientific claims in the media, and place scientific issues in appropriate context, so you can intelligently assess tradeoffs. You’ll learn how to determine whether a new study is really meaningful; uncover the difference between cause and coincidence; figure out which statistics mean something, and which don’t.

Seethaler reveals the tricks self-interested players use to mislead and confuse you, and points you to sources of information you can actually rely upon. Her many examples range from genetic engineering of crops to drug treatments for depression...but the techniques she teaches you will be invaluable in understanding any scientific controversy, in any area of science or health.

^   Potions, plots, and personalities: How science progresses, and why scientists sometimes disagree

^   Is it “cause” or merely coincidence? How to tell compelling evidence from a “good story”

^   There are always tradeoffs: How to put science and health claims in context, and understand their real implications

^   All the tricks experts use to fool you, exposed! How to recognize lies, “truthiness,” or pseudo-expertise
translatedDescription:
“Comprende, legible y repleto de ejemplos actuales y útiles, este libro proporciona una explicación muy necesaria de cómo ser un consumidor crítico de las afirmaciones científicas que encontramos en nuestra vida cotidiana”.

–April Cordero Maskiewicz, Departamento de Biología, Point Loma Nazarene University

“El libro de Seethaler ayuda al lector a mirar dentro de los trabajos de la ciencia y obtener una comprensión más profunda del camino que sigue un hallazgo científico – desde sus comienzos en un laboratorio de investigación hasta su aparición en las noticias nocturnas”.

–Jim Slotta, Ontario Institute for Studies in Education, University of Toronto

“¡Cómo deseo que la ciencia sea enseñada de esta manera! Seethaler desarrolla habilidades para el pensamiento crítico y la evaluación. El libro es rico con ejemplos que no sólo ilustran sus puntos hermosamente, también lo hacen muy interesante y divertido leer.”

–Julia R. Brown, Director, Targacept, Inc.

¡No te enganches! ¡Haz sentido de las noticias de salud y ciencias y toma decisiones más inteligentes!

Cada día, hay una nueva controversia científica o sanitaria. Y cada día, parece como si hubiera un nuevo estudio que contradice lo que escuchaste ayer. ¿Qué está pasando realmente? ¿Quién está diciendo la verdad? ¿Quién lo está fingiendo? ¿Qué saben los científicos, y qué no saben? Este libro te ayudará a cortar la confusión y tener sentido de todo, incluso si nunca has tomado una clase de ciencia! El líder del educador científico y periodista Dr. Sherry Seethaler revela cómo la ciencia y la investigación de salud realmente funcionan... cómo poner las reivindicaciones científicas en contexto y entender los verdaderos tradeoffs involucrados... investigación de calidad de la ciencia basura... descubrir cuándo alguien está deliberadamente tratando de engañarte... y encontrar más información en la que puedes confiar! Nadie sabe qué nueva controversia estallará mañana. Pero una cosa es cierta: Con este libro, usted sabrá cómo averiguar el verdadero trato, y tomar decisiones más inteligentes para usted y su familia!

Mira las noticias, y te abrumarán los fragmentos de la ciencia mal presentada: información que es incompleta, confusa, contradictoria, fuera de contexto, incorrecta o deshonesta. ¡Defiéndete! El Dr. Sherry Seethaler le da un poderoso arsenal de herramientas para tener sentido de la ciencia. Aprenderás a pensar con más sensatez sobre todo desde la enfermedad de las vacas locas hasta el calentamiento global, y cómo tomar mejores decisiones relacionadas con la ciencia tanto en tu vida personal como en un ciudadano.

Comenzarás por entender cómo la ciencia realmente funciona y progresa, y por qué los científicos a veces discrepan. Seethaler le ayuda a evaluar los posibles sesgos de aquellos que hacen afirmaciones científicas en los medios de comunicación, y colocar cuestiones científicas en el contexto adecuado, para que pueda evaluar de forma inteligente los tradeoffs. Aprenderás a determinar si un nuevo estudio es realmente significativo; descubrir la diferencia entre causa y coincidencia; averiguar qué estadísticas significan algo, y qué no.

Seethaler revela los trucos que los jugadores autointeresados usan para engañar y confundirte, y te señala a fuentes de información en las que realmente puedes confiar. Sus muchos ejemplos van desde la ingeniería genética de los cultivos hasta los tratamientos de drogas para la depresión... pero las técnicas que ella enseña serán inestimables para entender cualquier controversia científica, en cualquier área de ciencia o salud.

^ Pociones, parcelas y personalidades: Cómo progresa la ciencia, y por qué los científicos a veces discrepan

^ ¿Es “causa” o simplemente coincidencia? Cómo contar evidencia convincente de una “buena historia”

^ Siempre hay compensaciones: Cómo poner en contexto las reclamaciones de ciencia y salud, y entender sus implicaciones reales

^ Todos los trucos que los expertos usan para engañarte, expuesto! Cómo reconocer mentiras, “verdadería”, o pseudo-expertise

title: Reactive Microservices Architecture
description:
Still chugging along with a monolithic enterprise system that’s difficult to scale and maintain, and even harder to understand? In this concise book, Lightbend CTO Jonas Bonér explains why microservice-based architecture that consists of small, independent services is far more flexible than the traditional all-in-one systems that continue to dominate today’s enterprise landscape.

You’ll explore a microservice architecture, based on Reactive principles, for building an isolated service that’s scalable, resilient to failure, and combines with other services to form a cohesive whole. Specifically, you’ll learn how a Reactive microservice isolates everything (including failure), acts autonomously, does one thing well, owns state exclusively, embraces asynchronous message passing, and maintains mobility.

Bonér also demonstrates how Reactive microservices communicate and collaborate with other services to solve problems. Get a copy of this exclusive report and find out how to bring your enterprise system into the 21st century.

Jonas Bonér is Founder and CTO of Lightbend, inventor of the Akka project, co-author of the Reactive Manifesto and a Java Champion. Learn more at: http://jonasboner.com.
translatedDescription:
¿Todavía rebosando junto con un sistema de empresa monolítica que es difícil de escalar y mantener, e incluso más difícil de entender? En este libro conciso, Lightbend CTO Jonas Bonér explica por qué la arquitectura basada en microservicios que consiste en servicios pequeños e independientes es mucho más flexible que los sistemas tradicionales todo en uno que siguen dominando el panorama empresarial actual.

Explorarás una arquitectura de microservicio, basada en principios reactivos, para construir un servicio aislado que sea escalable, resistente al fracaso, y que se combina con otros servicios para formar un conjunto cohesivo. Específicamente, usted aprenderá cómo un microservicio reactiva aisla todo (incluido fracaso), actúa autónomamente, hace una cosa bien, posee estado exclusivamente, abraza el mensaje asincrónico que pasa, y mantiene la movilidad.

Bonér también demuestra cómo los microservicios reactivas comunican y colaboran con otros servicios para resolver problemas. Obtenga una copia de este informe exclusivo y descubra cómo llevar su sistema empresarial al siglo XXI.

Jonas Bonér es Fundador y CTO de Lightbend, inventor del proyecto Akka, coautor del Manifiesto Reactivo y campeón de Java. Más información en: http://jonasboner.com.

title: Word Hacks

But many, if not most, of them barely skim the surface of what is possible with Microsoft Word. Seduced by the application's supposed simplicity, they settle for just what's obvious--even if it doesn't satisfy their wants and needs. They may curse the wretched Bullets and Numbering buttons multiple times a day or take hours to change the font size of every heading in a lengthy report, yet they're reluctant to dig deeper to take advantage of Word's immense capabilities and limitless customization tools.Let Word Hacks be your shovel. Let it carve your way into Word and make this most popular and powerful application do precisely what you want it to do. Filled with insider tips, tools, tricks, and hacks, this book will turn you into the power user you always wanted to be. Far beyond a tutorial, Word Hacks assumes you have a solid working knowledge of the application and focuses on showing you exactly how to accomplish your pressing tasks, address your frequent annoyances, and solve even your most complex problems.Author Andrew Savikas examines Word's advanced (and often hidden) features and delivers clever, time-saving hacks on taming document bloat, customization, complex search and replace, Tables of Contents and indexes, importing and exporting files, tables and comments, and even using Google as a dictionary! With him as your guide, you'll soon be understanding--and hacking--Word in ways you never thought possible.Covering Word 2000, 2002 and Word 2003, Word Hacks exposes the inner workings of Word and releases your inner hacker; with it, you will be equipped to take advantage of the application s staggering array of advanced features that were once found only in page layout programs and graphics software and turning Word into your personal productivity powerhouse.

title: Technology and Society
description: Technology and Society traces the history of developments in science and technology from the Stone Age to modern times. It analyses how cultural attitudes and values have influenced their development and use, as well as the ways that technology in turn has influenced our lives, morals and culture, for better and for worse. The book also looks at recent developments in information and space technology, and closely examines the many facets of our prospects for survival in a safe and sustained world. Students of science and the humanities, as well as general readers interested in the subjects will find this lucid, engaging text an invaluable introduction to this vast, exciting and essential topic.

title: Numerical Simulation, An Art of Prediction 1
description: Numerical simulation is a technique of major importance in various technical and scientific fields. Used to understand diverse physical phenomena or to design everyday objects, it plays a major role in innovation in the industrial sector. Whilst engineering curricula now include training courses dedicated to it, numerical simulation is still not well-known in some economic sectors, and even less so among the general public. Simulation involves the mathematical modeling of the real world, coupled with the computing power offered by modern technology. Designed to perform virtual experiments, digital simulation can be considered as an "art of prediction". Embellished with a rich iconography and based on the testimony of researchers and engineers, this book shines a light on this little-known art. It is the first of two volumes and focuses on the principles, methods and industrial practice of numerical modeling.
translatedDescription: La simulación numérica es una técnica de gran importancia en diversos campos técnicos y científicos. Se utiliza para comprender diversos fenómenos físicos o para diseñar objetos cotidianos, juega un papel importante en la innovación en el sector industrial. Mientras que los planes de estudios de ingeniería ahora incluyen cursos de capacitación dedicados a él, la simulación numérica todavía no es conocida en algunos sectores económicos, e incluso menos entre el público en general. La simulación implica el modelado matemático del mundo real, junto con el poder informático ofrecido por la tecnología moderna. Diseñado para realizar experimentos virtuales, la simulación digital puede considerarse como un "arte de predicción". Enmarcado con una rica iconografía y basado en el testimonio de investigadores e ingenieros, este libro ilumina este arte poco conocido. Es el primero de dos volúmenes y se centra en los principios, métodos y práctica industrial del modelado numérico.

title: Scaling Chemical Processes
description:
Scaling Chemical Processes: Practical Guides in Chemical Engineering is one of a series of short texts that each provides a focused introductory view on a single subject. The full library spans the main topics in the chemical process industries for engineering professionals who require a basic grounding in various related topics. They are ‘pocket publications’ that the professional engineer can easily carry with them or access electronically while working. The focused facts provided in each guide will help you converse with experts in the field, attempt your own initial troubleshooting, check calculations, and solve rudimentary problems. This book discusses scaling chemical processes from a laboratory through a pilot plant to a commercial plant. This series is fully endorsed and co-branded by the IChemE, and they help to promote the series.

title: Metaverse and Immersive Technologies
description:
METAVERSE AND IMMERSIVE TECHNOLOGIES

The book covers the multidimensional perspectives of the metaverse through the prism of virtual reality, augmented reality, blockchain, artificial intelligence, and IoT, ranging from rudimentary to advanced applications.

This book provides a thorough explanation of how the technology behind metaverse and other virtual reality technologies are changing the world. The primary objective is to present the revolutionary innovation of the 21st century—the metaverse—and exhibit its wide range of applications in different domains. Although blockchain and VR/AR were the first popularly known applications of the metaverse, several other applications also exist. While some still believe the metaverse is overhyped, in reality, it is transforming almost every industry—healthcare, 3D, 4D, industry, game industry, business management, artificial intelligence, and IoT, just to name a few.

This technological breakthrough not only paved the way for virtual reality but also provided useful solutions for other areas of technology. The unique nature of the technology, which is a single, shared, immersive, persistent, 3D virtual space where humans experience life in ways not possible in the physical world, makes it suitable for all real-world applications; it has great potential to transform business, and companies are already in the race for different product offerings.

Audience

AI and computer science researchers, engineers and graduate students, IT personnel in business as well as entrepreneurs and policymakers.

METAVERSE AND IMMERSIVE TECHNOLOGIES

Este libro proporciona una explicación completa de cómo la tecnología detrás de las tecnologías metáversas y otras tecnologías de realidad virtual están cambiando el mundo. El objetivo principal es presentar la innovación revolucionaria del siglo XXI —el metaverso— y exponer su amplia gama de aplicaciones en diferentes ámbitos. Aunque blockchain y VR/AR fueron las primeras aplicaciones conocidas popularmente de la metaversa, existen también varias otras aplicaciones. Aunque algunos todavía creen que el metaverso está sobrecargado, en realidad, está transformando casi todas las industrias: atención de salud, 3D, 4D, industria, industria del juego, gestión de negocios, inteligencia artificial e IoT, sólo para nombrar algunos.

Este avance tecnológico no sólo allanó el camino para la realidad virtual, sino que también proporcionó soluciones útiles para otras áreas de la tecnología. La naturaleza única de la tecnología, que es un espacio virtual único, compartido, inmersivo, persistente, 3D donde los humanos experimentan la vida de maneras no posibles en el mundo físico, lo hace adecuado para todas las aplicaciones del mundo real; tiene un gran potencial para transformar el negocio, y las empresas ya están en la carrera para diferentes ofertas de productos.

Audiencia

Investigadores, ingenieros y estudiantes graduados de IA y ciencias informáticas, personal de TI en empresas y empresarios y responsables políticos.

description: “Virtual meeting fatigue” is no longer just a buzz phrase — it’s a measurable neurological phenomenon. Brain- and heart-monitoring experiments have shown that video calls drain us more than face-to-face meetings do, but a few practical fixes can boost meeting effectiveness and protect employee well-being.

title: Just Enough Requirements Management: Where Software Development Meets Marketing
description: This is the digital version of the printed book (Copyright © 2005). If you develop software without understanding the requirements, you're wasting your time. On the other hand, if a project spends too much time trying to understand the requirements, it will end up late and/or over-budget. And products that are created by such projects can be just as unsuccessful as those that fail to meet the basic requirements. Instead, every company must make a reasonable trade-off between what's required and what time and resources are available. Finding the right balance for your project may depend on many factors, including the corporate culture, the time-to-market pressure, and the criticality of the application. That is why requirements management—gathering requirements, identifying the "right" ones to satisfy, and documenting them—is essential. Just Enough Requirements Management shows you how to discover, prune, and document requirements when you are subjected to tight schedule constraints. You'll apply just enough process to minimize risks while still achieving desired outcomes. You'll determine how many requirements are just enough to satisfy your customers while still meeting your goals for schedule, budget, and resources. If your project has insufficient resources to satisfy all the requirements of your customers, you must read Just Enough Requirements Management.
translatedDescription: Esta es la versión digital del libro impreso (Copyright © 2005). Si desarrollas software sin entender los requisitos, estás perdiendo tu tiempo. Por otro lado, si un proyecto pasa demasiado tiempo tratando de entender los requisitos, terminará tarde y/o sobre-presupuesto. Y los productos creados por tales proyectos pueden ser tan infructuosos como aquellos que no cumplen con los requisitos básicos. En cambio, cada empresa debe hacer un intercambio razonable entre lo que se necesita y qué tiempo y recursos están disponibles. Encontrar el equilibrio adecuado para su proyecto puede depender de muchos factores, incluyendo la cultura corporativa, la presión de tiempo a mercado, y la crítica de la aplicación. Es por eso que la gestión de los requisitos, reunir los requisitos, identificar los "derechos" para satisfacerlos y documentarlos, es esencial. Sólo Suficiente Gestión de Requisitos le muestra cómo descubrir, prune y requisitos de documentos cuando usted está sujeto a restricciones de horario ajustados. Aplicará el proceso suficiente para minimizar los riesgos mientras aún logra los resultados deseados. Usted determinará cuántas necesidades son lo suficientemente justas para satisfacer a sus clientes mientras todavía cumple sus objetivos para el horario, presupuesto y recursos. Si su proyecto tiene recursos insuficientes para satisfacer todos los requisitos de sus clientes, debe leer Just enough requirements Management.

title: Mapping Clinical Value Streams
description: The mathematical underpinnings of games, whether they are strategic or games of chance, have been known for centuries, but are usually only understood by players and aficionados who have a background in mathematics. The author has succeeded in making that knowledge accessible, entertaining, and useful to everyone who likes to play and win. The information applies to such diverse and popular games as Roulette, Monopoly Chess, Go, numerous card games, and many more. He reviews the mathematical foundations, probability, combinatorics, and mathematical game theory, the field that won John Nash of A Beautiful Mind the Nobel Prize, and emphasizes the implementation of these techniques so that players can put them to work immediately. An extensive bibliography and sections describing the historical developments are welcome features to put the subject in a broader context
translatedDescription: Los fundamentos matemáticos de los juegos, ya sean estratégicos o juegos de azar, han sido conocidos por siglos, pero generalmente sólo son entendidos por jugadores y aficionados que tienen un fondo en matemáticas. El autor ha logrado que ese conocimiento sea accesible, entretenido y útil para todos los que les gusta jugar y ganar. La información se aplica a juegos tan diversos y populares como la Ruleta, Monopoly Chess, Go, numerosos juegos de cartas, y muchos más. Él revisa las bases matemáticas, probabilidad, combinatoria y teoría del juego matemático, el campo que ganó John Nash de una mente hermosa el Premio Nobel, y enfatiza la implementación de estas técnicas para que los jugadores puedan ponerlas a trabajar inmediatamente. Una extensa bibliografía y secciones que describen los acontecimientos históricos son características bienvenidas para poner el tema en un contexto más amplio

Understand the core principles and best practices of serverless and microservices architecture with .NET.
Implement and deploy Azure Functions to build serverless applications while managing costs effectively.

Apply advanced techniques to secure microservices, ensuring data integrity and authentication workflows.

Gabriel Baptista and Francesco Abbruzzese are seasoned software developers and authors with extensive experience in enterprise application architecture and .NET. This book is ideal for C# developers and software engineers proficient with the .NET stack, especially those looking to expand their expertise into cloud applications. With prior knowledge in ASP.NET Core and general programming concepts, readers will be able to transition seamlessly into microservices and serverless architectures. It caters to those aiming to understand the nuances, limitations, and opportunities of building modern distributed systems.

title: Office 2007: The Missing Manual

Quickly learn the most useful features of Microsoft Office 2007 with our easy to read four-in-one guide. Microsoft has replaced the familiar menus with a new tabbed toolbar (or "ribbon"), and added other features such as "live preview" that lets you see exactly what each option will look like in the document before you choose it. That's where Office 2007: The Missing Manual comes in. Rather than present a lot of arcane detail, this quick & friendly primer teaches you how to work with the most-used Office features, with four separate sections covering the four programs. Clear explanations
Step-by-step instructions
Lots of illustrations
Plenty of friendly advice

title: The Business of Influence: Reframing Marketing and PR for the Digital Age
description:
Media has most definitely evolved, as have the ways in which we contemplate, design, communicate and execute strategy. And rather than technological evolution, we're plainly in the midst of a technological revolution.

We have no choice then but to reframe marketing and PR in the context of 21st Century technology, 21st Century media and disintermediation, and 21st Century articulation of and appreciation for business strategy.

"Today, every organization is in the influence business. We influence customers to buy from us, employees to work for us, and the media to write about us. Gone are the days when you could be your own island. Now, to be successful, you need to live within the influence ecosystem and that requires a change of mindset. Fortunately, Philip Sheldrake will show you how."
translatedDescription:
Los medios de comunicación han evolucionado sin duda, al igual que las formas en que contemplamos, diseñamos, comunicamos y ejecutamos la estrategia. Y más que la evolución tecnológica, estamos claramente en medio de una revolución tecnológica.

Entonces no tenemos otra opción que reestructurar la comercialización y PR en el contexto de la tecnología del siglo XXI, los medios de comunicación y la desintermediación del siglo XXI y la articulación y apreciación de la estrategia empresarial.

"Hoy, cada organización está en el negocio de la influencia. Influimos en clientes para comprarnos, empleados para trabajar para nosotros, y los medios para escribir sobre nosotros. Se fueron los días en que podrías ser tu propia isla. Ahora, para tener éxito, necesitas vivir dentro del ecosistema de influencia y eso requiere un cambio de mentalidad. Afortunadamente, Philip Sheldrake te mostrará cómo."

title: Curious Folks Ask: 162 Real Answers on Amazing Inventions, Fascinating Products, and Medical Mysteries
description:
“Dr. Seethaler has written an excellent book for any interested student of science. She answers great questions about the world around us in this fascinating book. As a high school science teacher, I encounter many of these from my own students. I would highly recommend this book for anyone who has pondered questions starting with ‘how,’ ‘what,’ or ‘why.’”

–Ernest James Lo, Science Teacher, Woodside High School, Woodside, CA

Prepare to Be Fascinated!

Why does the flu change every year?

       • What makes glue sticky?

       • What causes out-of-body experiences?

       • Are all brands of gas the same?

       • Will adult stem cells work as well as embryonic stem cells?

       • Why can’t you sneeze with your eyes open?

       • How much does a cremated body weigh?

These are just a few of the fascinating science and health questions real people have asked top science writer and San Diego Union-Tribune columnist Sherry Seethaler. Curious Folks Ask brings together 162 of her best answers–all crystal-clear, accurate, quick, and a pleasure to read. Seethaler is one of this generation’s best science explainers, and it shows: Every answer is accurate, fun to read, and distilled to a single page or less! Want to know how canned air works…or nuclear bombs? What causes goose bumps, earwax, dandruff, headaches? Whether it’s healthy to crack your knuckles, drink decaf, eat chocolate? What it costs to run all those LED lights around your house? It’s all here–and a whole lot more!

Your body’s oddities: knees to knuckles, itches to sneezesSurprising facts about how your body grows and works

Our ingenious inventionsThe past, present, and future of our relentless human inventiveness

Pesky pathogens: viruses, bacteria, and prionsHow they keep outsmarting us, and why it’s so hard to stay healthy

title: Learning from Experience
description: An important task facing all clinicians, and especially challenging for younger, less experienced clinicians, is to come to know oneself sufficiently to be able to register the patient's experience in useful and progressively deeper ways.  In an effort to aid younger clinicians in the daily struggle to "know thyself," Marilyn Charles turns to key ideas that have facilitated her own clinical work with difficult patients.  Concepts such as "container" and "contained," transitional space, projective identification, and transference/countertransference are introduced not as academic ideas, but as aspects of the therapeutic environment that elicit greater creativity and vitality on the therapist's part.  In Charles's skillful hands, the basic ideas of Klein, Winnicott, and Bion become newly comprehensible without losing depth and richness; they come to life in the fulcrum of daily clinical encounter.
translatedDescription: Una tarea importante a la que se enfrentan todos los médicos, y especialmente desafiante para los médicos más jóvenes y menos experimentados, es conocerse lo suficiente para poder registrar la experiencia del paciente de maneras útiles y progresivamente más profundas. En un esfuerzo por ayudar a los médicos más jóvenes en la lucha diaria por "conocerse", Marilyn Charles se convierte en ideas clave que han facilitado su propio trabajo clínico con pacientes difíciles. Conceptos como "container" y "contenidos", espacio de transición, identificación proyectiva, y transferencia/contratransferencia se introducen no como ideas académicas, sino como aspectos del entorno terapéutico que genera mayor creatividad y vitalidad por parte del terapeuta. En las hábiles manos de Carlos, las ideas básicas de Klein, Winnicott y Bion se vuelven recién comprensibles sin perder profundidad y riqueza; vienen a la vida en el fulcrum del encuentro clínico diario.

title: Word 2007: The Missing Manual
description:
Microsoft Word has grown considerably in power, sophistication and capability over the past decade, but one thing that hasn't changed since the early '90s is its user interface. The simple toolbar in version 2.0 has been packed with so many features since then that few users know where to find them all. Consequently, more and more people are looking for "insider" tips that will allow them to use these advanced and often hidden features. Microsoft has addressed this problem in Word 2007 by radically redesigning the user interface with a tabbed toolbar that makes every feature easy to locate and use. Unfortunately, Microsoft's documentation is as scant as ever, so even though you will be able to find advanced features, you might not know what to do with them.

Word 2007: The Missing Manual, written specifically for this version of the software, explains basics like how to create documents, enter and edit text, format, print, and fax. You will will also learn how to create sophisticated page layouts, insert forms and tables, use graphics, and create book-length documents with outlines and Master Documents. Coverage also includes how to share documents with other people and programs, create web pages, automate documents with fields, and automate tasks with macros and the Visual Basic scripting language. This book shows you how to do it all.

Microsoft Word ha crecido considerablemente en potencia, sofisticación y capacidad en la última década, pero una cosa que no ha cambiado desde principios de los 90 es su interfaz de usuario. En consecuencia, más y más personas están buscando consejos "interiores" que les permitirán usar estas características avanzadas y a menudo ocultas. Microsoft ha abordado este problema en Word 2007 rediseñando radicalmente la interfaz de usuario con una barra de herramientas de tabbed que hace que cada característica sea fácil de localizar y utilizar. Desafortunadamente, la documentación de Microsoft es tan escasa como siempre, así que aunque usted será capaz de encontrar características avanzadas, es posible que no sepa qué hacer con ellos.

Word 2007: El Manual de Desaparecimiento, escrito específicamente para esta versión del software, explica aspectos básicos como cómo crear documentos, introducir y editar texto, formato, impresión y fax. También aprenderá a crear diseños de páginas sofisticados, insertar formularios y tablas, utilizar gráficos y crear documentos de longitud de libro con esquemas y Documentos Maestros. La cobertura también incluye cómo compartir documentos con otras personas y programas, crear páginas web, automatizar documentos con campos y automatizar tareas con macros y el lenguaje de scripting Visual Basic. Este libro te muestra cómo hacerlo todo.

title: Willful Ignorance: The Mismeasure of Uncertainty
description:
An original account of willful ignorance and how this principle relates to modern probability and statistical methods

Through a series of colorful stories about great thinkers and the problems they chose to solve, the author traces the historical evolution of probability and explains how statistical methods have helped to propel scientific research. However, the past success of statistics has depended on vast, deliberate simplifications amounting to willful ignorance, and this very success now threatens future advances in medicine, the social sciences, and other fields. Limitations of existing methods result in frequent reversals of scientific findings and recommendations, to the consternation of both scientists and the lay public.

Willful Ignorance: The Mismeasure of Uncertainty exposes the fallacy of regarding probability as the full measure of our uncertainty. The book explains how statistical methodology, though enormously productive and influential over the past century, is approaching a crisis. The deep and troubling divide between qualitative and quantitative modes of research, and between research and practice, are reflections of this underlying problem. The author outlines a path toward the re-engineering of data analysis to help close these gaps and accelerate scientific discovery.

Willful Ignorance: The Mismeasure of Uncertainty presents essential information and novel ideas that should be of interest to anyone concerned about the future of scientific research. The book is especially pertinent for professionals in statistics and related fields, including practicing and research clinicians, biomedical and social science researchers, business leaders, and policy-makers.
translatedDescription:
Un relato original de ignorancia voluntaria y cómo este principio se relaciona con la probabilidad moderna y los métodos estadísticos

A través de una serie de historias coloridas sobre grandes pensadores y los problemas que eligieron resolver, el autor traza la evolución histórica de la probabilidad y explica cómo los métodos estadísticos han ayudado a impulsar la investigación científica. Sin embargo, el éxito pasado de las estadísticas ha dependido de grandes simplificaciones deliberadas que equivalen a ignorancia deliberada, y este éxito amenaza ahora los futuros avances en la medicina, las ciencias sociales y otros campos. Las limitaciones de los métodos existentes dan lugar a frecuentes reveses de conclusiones y recomendaciones científicas, a la consternación tanto de científicos como del público laico.

Ignorancia voluntaria: La falta de certeza de la incertidumbre expone la falacia de la probabilidad como la medida completa de nuestra incertidumbre. El libro explica cómo la metodología estadística, aunque enormemente productiva e influyente durante el siglo pasado, se acerca a una crisis. La profunda y preocupante brecha entre modos cualitativos y cuantitativos de investigación, y entre investigación y práctica, son reflejos de este problema subyacente. El autor esboza un camino hacia la reorganización del análisis de datos para ayudar a cerrar estas lagunas y acelerar el descubrimiento científico.

Ignorancia voluntaria: La falta de certeza de la incertidumbre presenta información esencial y ideas novedosas que deben ser de interés para cualquier persona interesada en el futuro de la investigación científica. El libro es especialmente pertinente para profesionales en estadística y campos relacionados, incluyendo practicantes y médicos, investigadores biomédicos y de ciencias sociales, líderes empresariales y responsables de políticas.

This engaging book offers practical ways for non-marketing managers and executives to measure and improve marketing returns. It gives you the tools you need to be able to correctly assess the potential of your marketing and accurately evaluate the returns. You’ll learn:

How to evaluate your marketing investment’s likely ROI before you invest the money.

How well your own organization is performing in the management of its marketing investments.

title: Optical Switches
description:
Optical communication using optical fibres as the transmission medium is essential to handling the massive growth of both telecom and datacom traffic. To fully realize the potential bandwidth available on these optical fibres, other components of the optical network system have to be developed, ranging from detectors and multiplexers to buffers and switches. This book addresses the different technologies which can be applied to switching optical signals.An optical switch functions by selectively switching an optical signal delivered through an optical fibre or in an integrated optical circuit to another. Several methods are available and each relies on a different physical mechanism for its operation. The various physical mechanisms used are discussed in the main chapters in the book which cover electro-optical, thermo-optical, micro-electro-mechanical (MEMS)-based and semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA)-based optical switches. The book also covers switching based on optical nonlinear effects, liquid and photonic crystal optical switches as well as fibre, holographic, quantum optical and other types of optical switches. Each chapter discusses the choice of materials, fabrication techniques and key issues in switch design.With its distinguished editors and international team of contributors, Optical switches: materials and design is a standard reference for the telecommunications industry and those researching this important topic.
Reviews this commercially significant area of research and addresses the different technologies which can be applied to switching optical signals
Provides a balanced look at the developments which can be defined as key trends in optical switches
Major optical switches including electro-optical, thermo optical and magneto-optical switches are discussed and the respective theory and principles of each explored
translatedDescription:
La comunicación óptica mediante fibras ópticas como medio de transmisión es esencial para manejar el crecimiento masivo del tráfico de telecomunicaciones y de datacom. Para realizar plenamente el potencial ancho de banda disponible en estas fibras ópticas, hay que desarrollar otros componentes del sistema de red óptica, que van desde detectores y multiplexadores hasta buffers y conmutadores. Este libro aborda las diferentes tecnologías que se pueden aplicar para cambiar las señales ópticas. Un interruptor óptico funciona cambiando selectivamente una señal óptica entregada a través de una fibra óptica o en un circuito óptico integrado a otro. Hay varios métodos disponibles y cada uno depende de un mecanismo físico diferente para su funcionamiento. Los diversos mecanismos físicos utilizados se discuten en los capítulos principales del libro que cubren los interruptores ópticos basados en electro-ópticos, termopticos, microelectro-mecánicos (MEMS) y semiconductores (SOA). El libro también cubre la conmutación basada en efectos ópticos no lineales, interruptores ópticos de cristal líquido y fotonico, así como fibra, holografía, óptica cuántica y otros tipos de interruptores ópticos. Cada capítulo analiza la elección de materiales, técnicas de fabricación y cuestiones clave en el diseño de interruptores. Con sus distinguidos editores y equipo internacional de colaboradores, los interruptores ópticos: materiales y diseño es una referencia estándar para la industria de telecomunicaciones y aquellos que investigan este importante tema.
Reseña este área comercialmente significativa de investigación y aborda las diferentes tecnologías que se pueden aplicar para cambiar las señales ópticas
Proporciona una visión equilibrada de los desarrollos que pueden definirse como tendencias clave en los interruptores ópticos
Se discuten los principales interruptores ópticos, incluyendo interruptores electro-opticos, termo ópticos y magneto-optical y la teoría y principios respectivos de cada uno explorado

title: SEO & PPC: Better Together
description: In SEO & PPC: Better Together, Melanie Mitchell shows how to use search engine optimization (SEO) and pay-per-click (PPC) together to achieve better results than either can deliver alone. You’ll learn how to integrate SEO and PPC in campaigns that engage more consumers and use data from both to improve the performance of each. Mitchell begins by comparing the paid and organic search marketing “pathways,” reviewing applications, overlaps, differences, strengths, weaknesses, and tradeoffs. Next, Mitchell shows how paid search data can be a gold mine when figuring out where to focus your SEO efforts, and understanding what content to optimize or build based on your actual ROI rather than relying on indirect traffic estimates from keyword research tools. She presents the latest research on synergies between SEO and PPC, shows how to handle new analytical complexities introduced by changes in Google’s search privacy policies, and offers practical, step-by-step guidance for building a KPI-linked dashboard that organizes your data and makes it more usable. From start to finish, Mitchell’s techniques and guidance are designed to help marketers become smarter about focusing their time and budgets, evaluating current returns, and optimizing the value of every campaign they create.

Aprenderás a integrar SEO y PPC en campañas que involucran a más consumidores y utilizan datos de ambos para mejorar el rendimiento de cada uno. Mitchell comienza comparando el marketing de búsquedas pagado y orgánico “pareñas”, revisando aplicaciones, superposiciones, diferencias, fortalezas, debilidades y desvíos. A continuación, Mitchell muestra cómo los datos de búsqueda pagados pueden ser una mina de oro al averiguar dónde enfocar sus esfuerzos de SEO, y entender qué contenido para optimizar o construir basado en su ROI real en lugar de depender de estimaciones de tráfico indirectas de herramientas de investigación de palabras clave. Presenta la última investigación sobre sinergias entre SEO y PPC, muestra cómo manejar nuevas complejidades analíticas introducidas por cambios en las políticas de privacidad de búsqueda de Google, y ofrece orientación práctica y paso a paso para construir un dashboard conectado con KPI que organiza sus datos y lo hace más utilizable. De principio a fin, las técnicas y la orientación de Mitchell están diseñadas para ayudar a los marketers a ser más inteligentes para enfocar su tiempo y presupuestos, evaluar los rendimientos actuales y optimizar el valor de cada campaña que crean.

title: Platonism, Naturalism, and Mathematical Knowledge
description: This study addresses a central theme in current philosophy: Platonism vs Naturalism and provides accounts of both approaches to mathematics, crucially discussing Quine, Maddy, Kitcher, Lakoff, Colyvan, and many others. Beginning with accounts of both approaches, Brown defends Platonism by arguing that only a Platonistic approach can account for concept acquisition in a number of special cases in the sciences. He also argues for a particular view of applied mathematics, a view that supports Platonism against Naturalist alternatives. Not only does this engaging book present the Platonist-Naturalist debate over mathematics in a comprehensive fashion, but it also sheds considerable light on non-mathematical aspects of a dispute that is central to contemporary philosophy.
translatedDescription: Este estudio aborda un tema central en la filosofía actual: Platonismo vs Naturalismo y proporciona relatos de ambos enfoques matemáticos, discutiendo crucialmente Quine, Maddy, Kitcher, Lakoff, Colyvan, y muchos otros. Comenzando con relatos de ambos enfoques, Brown defiende el Platonismo argumentando que sólo un enfoque platonista puede dar cuenta de la adquisición de concepto en varios casos especiales en las ciencias. También defiende una visión particular de las matemáticas aplicadas, una visión que apoya el platonismo contra las alternativas naturalistas. No sólo este libro atractivo presenta el debate Platonista-Naturalista sobre las matemáticas de manera integral, sino que también arroja una luz considerable sobre aspectos no matemáticos de una disputa que es central a la filosofía contemporánea.

title: Cost-Based, Charge-Based, and Contractual Payment Systems

Describes where healthcare payment systems are headed in the future
